title: Context Fabric Individual document, contract 3
description: Private machine bindings with named credential sources, explicit environment-variable slots, and this machine's local resources and path purposes.

kind.description: Which contract tier this document uses.

schema_version.description: The Individual contract version this document uses.

bindings.description: One entry per shared document this machine binds.

local_path.title: Local path
local_path.description: A path on this machine. Individual is the only tier where machine-local paths belong.

binding.title: Binding
binding.description: One shared document and the machine-local information needed to use it.

ref.description: The shared document being bound and the release this binding observed.

documents_root.description: The folder on this machine holding authored documents.

framework_root.description: The framework checkout this binding runs from.

checkout_root.description: The code checkout where work happens, when there is one.

output_root.description: Where generated views and instructions are written on this machine.

harness.description: The agent harness that reads the generated instructions.

location_override.description: A machine-local override for the shared reference location.

instruction_installed.description: Generated instruction copies tracked so stale installations can be reported.

secrets.description: Named credential sources and the environment-variable slots that select them.

path_purposes.description: One line per path slot saying what that slot is for on this machine.

local_resources.description: Directories and command-line tools on this machine that work under this binding uses. Private to this machine: none of it reaches a shared document or a generated view.

harness.title: Harness
harness.description: The agent harness in use for this binding.

instruction_file.description: The filename the harness reads when it differs from the framework default.

installed_instruction.title: Installed instruction
installed_instruction.description: One generated instruction file copied somewhere a harness reads.

document.description: The document whose generated instructions these are.

path.description: Where the copy was installed on this machine.

purpose.description: Why this copy is installed where it is.

secrets.title: Credential bindings
secrets.description: Declarative credential sources and slots. These fields never hold resolved credential values.

sources.description: Binding-local source names mapped to versioned provider declarations.

env.description: Environment-variable slots mapped to one declared source and one provider-specific locator.

credential_source.title: Credential source
credential_source.description: A named provider selection and its non-secret configuration.

provider.description: The provider identifier selected from the framework registry.

provider_contract.description: The provider contract version selected independently of the Individual contract.

configuration.description: Provider-specific, non-secret configuration validated by the selected provider contract.

credential_slot.title: Credential slot
credential_slot.description: One environment variable's source selection and provider-specific locator.

source.description: The binding-local source name this slot selects.

locator.description: A provider-specific reference envelope. It identifies where a credential lives and never contains the credential value.

purpose.description: One line, at most 160 characters, saying what this is for.

path_purposes.title: Path purposes
path_purposes.description: A purpose note for each path slot that has one. The slots stay plain paths; their notes live here, keyed by slot name.

documents_root.description: What documents_root is for on this machine.

framework_root.description: What framework_root is for on this machine.

checkout_root.description: What checkout_root is for on this machine.

output_root.description: What output_root is for on this machine.

location_override.description: What location_override is for on this machine.

local_resource.title: Local resource
local_resource.description: One directory or command-line tool on this machine, what it is for, and optionally the shared system and interface it serves. A link the bound document no longer has is reported, never re-pointed.

id.description: This resource's identifier, unique within its binding.

kind.description: What sort of resource it is.

path.description: Where it is on this machine.

system.description: The shared system it serves, when it serves one.

interface.description: The interface of that system it serves, when it serves one. Requires system.

local_resource_system.title: Local resource system
local_resource_system.description: A system named as the bound document's view names it: a system id of a bound Org, or on a bound Bounded Context <document-id>#<system-id>, where the document is an Org it extends or the Bounded Context itself for a system it declares.
